<!-- theorem-1: body_md -->
\label{thm:main}
Uniformly for $\max\{2,\log z\}\leqslant  y\leqslant  z\leqslant  x/2$, we have
\[
\Theta(x,y,z)
=\frac{x{\rm e}^{O(v)}}{\{v\log(3v)\}^{v}}.
\]
The implied constant is absolute.
<!-- end theorem-1 -->
<!-- head-1: body_md -->
We write $P^+(n)$ and $P^-(n)$ for the largest and smallest prime factors
of $n$, with the convention $P^+(1)=1$, $P^-(1)=\infty$, and put
\[
\Psi(t,y):=\#\{n\leqslant  t:P^+(n)\leqslant  y\},
\qquad
\Phi(t,y):=\#\{n\leqslant  t:P^-(n)>y\}.
\]
The letters $\varrho$ and $\omega$ denote the Dickman and Buchstab functions,
respectively. All sums over integers are over positive integers unless
otherwise specified; implied constants are absolute.
<!-- end head-1 -->
